exactPrompts.initial:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one premium horse mascot illustration cutout for a landing page, square canvas, genuinely transparent RGBA background.
Input images: Image 1 is a character appearance and rendering-quality reference only. Use the horse character as reference; do not reproduce the poster, background, typography, names, or symbols.
Primary request: a polished film-quality 3D-style illustration of the friendly white horse mascot seen in the reference. Preserve the horse's appealing smooth anatomy, compact upright body, large expressive blue eyes, soft muzzle and nostrils, confident intelligent smile, long ears, sculpted layered mane, and flowing curled tail. The mane and tail are primarily cobalt, bright cyan, and turquoise, with at most a tiny restrained green accent inspired by the reference. Navy hooves and an entirely plain dark navy fabric vest, without any emblem or decoration.
Pose/composition: full-body front three-quarter view, facing mostly toward the camera. One foreleg is raised in a friendly wave with clear transparent separation from the head and body; the other foreleg rests naturally near the side. Both standing hooves, complete tail, mane tips, raised foreleg, and both ears are fully inside the canvas. Character fills about 84 percent of the image height with about 8 percent clear margin above and below. Natural balanced stance, readable silhouette, smooth sophisticated anatomy.
Style/materials: highly refined 3D-rendered character illustration, appealing sculpted proportions, detailed layered mane shapes, subtly subsurface-scattering white coat, refined roughness and delicate cloth texture on the vest, deep blue irises with clean eye highlights, smooth natural transitions between anatomical forms. Match or exceed the rendering sophistication of the reference; no crude primitive shapes, boxy robot, or low-poly toy approximation.
Lighting: soft studio area key light and gentle fill, clean white-coat detail, controlled highlights, no harsh rim glow. Preserve color separation between the white body, cobalt/cyan mane, and navy clothing.
Transparency: output an actual transparent background with an alpha channel. Isolate only the complete horse character. All surrounding pixels and openings between limbs must be transparent. No floor, ground plane, background scenery, baked background rectangle, checkerboard pattern, cast ground shadow, or platform.
Constraints: absolutely no text, lettering, name, watermark, logo, horse-head logo, speech bubble, audio symbol, badge, or chest graphic anywhere. The vest must be completely plain navy fabric. Do not reproduce the reference poster or its branding. No extra props or palette colors. This deliverable is a raster illustration, not a 3D model.
